data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A single model call produces better surviving conjectures in novel domains because bounded harnesses induce 'constraint collapse,' prematurely pruning low-probability, high-reward solution paths that do not fit pre-defined structural molds.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the domain is well-constrained and the 'correct' answer strictly follows the harness structure, the entropy of a single call yields mostly noise.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the harness includes a 'relaxation' phase (simulated annealing) where constraints are loosened initially, the pruning effect is mitigated.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If 'better' is defined strictly by adherence to a school stance (e.g., mechanist), then non-compliant novel discoveries are inferior by definition.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Entropy Preservation: Single calls sample from the full prior distribution of the model.
